high_level_description: stc brand style, a dramatic profile portrait of a woman in a hijab and glasses lit with cyberpunk-style blue and red neon lighting.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A completely dark background that makes the neon-lit subject stand out, with deep blue tones on the left and vibrant red highlights on the right.

elements.desc: A young woman wearing a light-colored hijab and round wire-frame glasses, shown in profile with her hand raised to touch the glasses.
